What we covered
- Hosted API is the fastest way to get started: simple REST + SDK, no infra.
- Endpoints: 
  - Text generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  - Embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings

- Quickstart: create an API key, run the sample curl below, then try the streaming example in the quickstart guide.

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

Hi Olivia — great questions. Short answers here; Rishi (cc'd) will follow up with a bit more detail and some attachments around compliance/Dedicated sizing.

Rate limits (Hosted API)
- Default request rate: 60 requests/min per API key.
- Token throughput: default organizations are throttled to a conservative token rate (example: ~150k tokens/min org-level burst) — exact numbers vary by account and plan. For a POC we can temporarily increase quotas to cover end-of-day bursts.

When customers move to Dedicated or Private
- Hosted: best for fast POCs and early production when you want no infra and fast onboarding. SOC 2 + encryption in transit & at rest are standard for Hosted; we can provide SOC 2 summary/attestation.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools when you need predictable throughput/latency and isolation; typical when sustained high throughput or strict performance SLOs are required.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): used for regulated customers that require customer-managed networking, custom KMS/HSM, or air-gapped deployments.

For FinTechX POC recommendation
- Start on Hosted to validate integration and generate the eval metrics we need. If you hit sustained throughput or strict data residency requirements, we'll move to Dedicated or Private as the next step.

I attached the quickstart PDF again for convenience. Rishi, can you share a short note on Dedicated throughput characteristics and SOC 2 evidence we can provide to procurement?

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Olivia — Rishi here (SE), following up with the technical details Marissa promised. Quick summary tailored to your questions.

Hosted API limits & burst handling
- Request rate: default 60 reqs/min per API key.
- Token throughput: org-level defaults are conservative for shared-hosted tenants; typical baseline we see is ~150k tokens/min with ability to burst higher for short periods.
- If you need steady high throughput for reconciliation windows, we recommend either:
  1) Temporary quota raise on Hosted for the POC (fast, no infra changes).
  2) Redwood Dedicated: reserved capacity. Dedicated nodes give you predictable per-GPU throughput and isolation; we provide guidance on expected rps/tokens per GPU and can map to your expected traffic to recommend cluster size.

Security & compliance
- Hosted: SOC 2 Type II attestation available; data encrypted in transit & at rest. We'll attach SOC2_summary.pdf for procurement review.
- Private: offers VPC and on-prem options with customer-managed KMS/HSM when required by policy.

Attachments
- SOC2_summary.pdf (summary of controls and attestation)
- dedicated-options.pdf (overview of Dedicated tiers, throughput numbers, and pricing ranges)

Next steps
1) Marissa will provision an eval API key and sample dataset access.
2) If you'd like, we'll schedule a 45-min tech deep-dive this week to size Dedicated if you expect sustained high throughput.

If procurement needs a copy of the SOC 2 report, we can provide the redacted attestation and a workshare NDA.
